data.completion_memo: Completed the independent-clone Git collaboration gate and removed Git-tracked application request history as directed. Text format version 2 exports project content only; request retry results use the existing ignored .adashi/local/state.json and do not transfer across clean clones. Fresh no-op requests and retries preserve tracked bytes and mtimes. Version 1 reads remain passive; its next successful write atomically removes legacy request files and upgrades the marker, with recovery and external-edit protection. SQLite/text migration preserves local retry results on the same checkout without recreating tracked request history. Also fixed ambiguous task/QA link ordering after merges and native draft reload blur autosaving discarded content. Verification: 205 application Rust tests passed, 5 pre-existing ignored; 15 real Git/MCP scenarios and 5 native Tauri/WebView2 scenarios passed. Frontend build and versioned-draft regression passed. Final binaries rebuilt; targeted upgrade/migration tests passed after final cleanup. Git evidence: target/git-collaboration/5998fe38-f0be-4bb9-88e1-36ce12de6613/evidence.json. Native evidence and screenshots: target/git-collaboration/5998fe38-f0be-4bb9-88e1-36ce12de6613/native-evidence.json. Everyday workflow and documented limits: docs/storage-git-collaboration.md. Formal storage-text design updated. No acceptance decision remains pending. Source changes remain uncommitted.

lines:
Execution order: step 09 of 13. Depends on Adashi task ID 18. Complete this prerequisite before starting.

Phase: Git-friendly text storage completion gate.

Use real Git repositories and at least two independent clones to prove collaboration:
- Merge simultaneous additions, including task/QA creation, and verify stable IDs, display-number behavior and references.
- Merge disjoint resource edits with no unnecessary conflicts; test same-resource disjoint fields according to the documented format.
- Exercise overlapping edits, delete/edit and delete/reference conflicts, reordered lists, multiline artifacts, unresolved markers and semantically invalid but syntactically clean merges.
- Verify branch switching, pull, merge and recovery with the app open, including stale desktop drafts and MCP readTokens.
- Test two local processes, interrupted writes, clean-clone reconstruction and SQLite/text round-trip migration.
- Confirm repeated reads and no-op writes leave tracked bytes unchanged; caches, machine paths and secrets are absent from tracked storage.

Acceptance: automated Git scenarios and native desktop/MCP evidence demonstrate both users' valid work survives, true conflicts are visible and recoverable, and neither client silently overwrites merged data. Document the everyday commit/pull/merge workflow and practical limits.

Resolved implementation direction 2026-09-24: Application request history is excluded from Git-tracked text storage. Retry results remain in the existing ignored local state, with no cross-clone replay guarantee. Format version 2 preserves tracked bytes and mtimes for fresh no-op requests and retries. Version 1 remains read-only compatible and removes legacy tracked request records on its next successful write. The one-time format upgrade is documented; ordinary version 2 no-op requests leave Git clean.

data.title: Storage 09/13 — Verify Git collaboration with independent clones
